heading: Protect information
content: Hyper-ABS minimizes, masks, redacts, tokenizes, or abstracts unnecessary sensitive values before approved context reaches inference.

heading: Control execution
content: Hyper Tern checks identity, permissions, routing, tools, resources, and requested actions against explicit policy boundaries.

heading: Manage agent authority
content: Hyper Wallet manages agent identity, credentials, policy-bound permissions, and delegated approvals without acting as a custody or payment product.

heading: Preserve evidence
content: Hyper-0x records attributable, tamper-evident execution evidence for verification, audit, and settlement without claiming model truth.
